issue.description:
ADR-005 records as a drawback of the new doctor `ready_frontier` check that there is no way to mark an assignment as intentionally held, so an operator who legitimately parks work under an assignee gets a permanent warning and learns to ignore the diagnostic. Work: design a minimal explicit reservation marker creatable only through a public CLI operation (preserving the never-write-SQLite rule), teach the ready_frontier check to exclude or distinctly annotate marked assignments, keep the check advisory-only even under `--repair`, document the field semantics in the schema field guide, and add checkpoint round-trip and unknown-field corpus coverage for the new state.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Let operators mark an assignment as intentionally held so the ready-frontier warning can distinguish parked work

issue.description:
ADR-005 (Accepted 2026-08-16) decided doctor gains a ready_frontier check under the dependencies scope, warning when open issues carry an assignee and naming a bounded id sample plus the exact remedy (`bead update <id> --clear-assignee`). The supplied docs still describe this state as silent ('bead show and bead doctor both report it as healthy') and no open bead covers the check. Implement advisory-only — doctor never clears an assignee, not even under --repair. Tests: assigned-open issues warn; --repair leaves them untouched; in_progress claims and blocked issues do not false-positive.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add the ADR-005 doctor ready_frontier check for assigned-but-open starvation
